answer_1.quote: Summarizing video content into a natural language description (i.e. 'video captioning') is a crucial aspect of video understanding.

answer_2.quote: We use the standard BLEU-4 (B-4), Rouge-L (R-L) and CIDEr metrics used in captioning tasks. We also calculate an Entity F 1 (Ent. F 1 ) score to measure how well the ground-truth entities are covered in the generated caption.

answer_3.quote: We ask a LLM rater to score the quality of captions according to the following criteria: 1) It should contain the name of important entities (people, place, organizations etc.); 2) It should not hallucinate; 3) It should not leave out critical information from the event descriptions.
criteria: does not leave out critical information

answer_4.quote: We employ a human-in-the-loop procedure for this task.
answer_4.guideline: We manually rated a gold set of 100 samples and also asked the LLM raters to rate it.
